comment: Base bundles for USB flashing - see FLASH_PLAN.md. A bootloader MUST come from the same ESP-IDF release as the firmware: bootloadersByChip lists one per release, tagged with the idfVer string inside it, and the flasher picks the one matching the app image's idf_ver (the first is the default for an image with no descriptor). All are the qio_80m ELF from the core's libs patched to a DIO header via 'esptool elf2image --flash-mode dio --flash-freq 80m --flash-size 4MB' - pioarduino and the Arduino IDE share the same libs per release, so one serves both; the core named is the one it was built from. Do NOT use the dio_80m ELF: it is a different binary and did not work. The pioarduino C3 for v5.5.4 is byte-identical to a real pioarduino build; the rest are unverified against a reference build. Flash-size independent (esptool patches the header at write time). Partition tables are chip-independent, and are the core's stock CSVs, so they match what a PlatformIO env using the same scheme writes. boot_app0.bin is universal.
